items.title: I'm curious to see how the Jazz adapt with Jusuf Nurkic out to open the season. Jaren Jackson Jr. at the five, especially starting there, hasn't worked well, historically. Jaxson Hayes starts with Kyle Filipowski, Mo Bamba and small-ball behind him is probably the way Utah goes.
